_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja Airlock/Sluza (113 terminow, ~27 mikroscen) - pokoj Tadpole (nurkini), zdekorowany morskimi pamiatkami. Zawiera studnie sluzy prowadzaca do zalanej skrzyni ze skarbem, zagadke z hełmem do nurkowania/sejfem, oraz butelki z sekretami - w tym odkrycie DRUGIEJ tajnej strony Kontraktu Dowodczego Sinthii.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci. Scena 'bottles 3 Tadpole stops us breaking it' - linia 'I don't go around breaking your stuff' przypisana do Tadpole (broni swoich rzeczy), w przeciwienstwie do niemal identycznej sceny 'bottles 2' (Tadpole nieobecna), gdzie te sama kwestie mowi Grimoire z szacunku dla jej wlasnosci pod jej nieobecnosc.

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.en: Only one way to find out.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.pl: Jest tylko jeden sposób, żeby się dowiedzieć.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.en: Huh. It's been drained of water...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.en: I thought it was a diving airlock...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.en: ...but maybe it's just a ballast tank?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.pl: ...ale może to po prostu zbiornik balastowy?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Airlock2/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_AirlockHole_Ch.en: It's a treasure chest. We can't reach it while it's underwater.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_AirlockHole_Ch.pl: To skrzynia ze skarbem. Nie możemy jej dosięgnąć, dopóki jest pod wodą.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_AirlockHole_Ch.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_AirlockHole_wa.en:
It's filled up with water.
We can't go down there.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_AirlockHole_wa.pl:
Wypełniło się wodą.
Nie możemy tam zejść.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_AirlockHole_wa.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_LockedBoxStart.en:
It's a diving helmet.
One of those old heavy ones.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_LockedBoxStart.pl:
To hełm do nurkowania.
Jeden z tych starych, ciężkich.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_LockedBoxStart.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Pocketbook Ask.en: Tadpole didn't give us the code for the pocketbook.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Pocketbook Ask.pl: Tadpole nie dała nam kodu do notesu.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Pocketbook Ask.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Pocketbook Ask.en: I knew that would cheer you up.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Pocketbook Ask.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Pocketbook Ask.en: -if we ask everyone, and [i]nobody[/i] knows it, we can break it open.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Pocketbook Ask.pl: -jeśli zapytamy wszystkich i [i]nikt[/i] go nie zna, możemy go rozbić.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_Pocketbook Ask.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.en: I think it's the lid that fits over the airlock. It's been taken off the hinge.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.pl: Chyba to pokrywa pasująca do śluzy. Została zdjęta z zawiasu.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.en:
So there's no lid?
What if it floods?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.pl:
Więc nie ma pokrywy?
A co, jeśli zaleje?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.en: As long as we're aligned on that.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.pl: Dobrze, że się w tej kwestii zgadzamy.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_airlocklid/Sec.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.en: It's the kind of mirror you'd walk through to get to mirror world.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.pl: To taki rodzaj lustra, przez które wchodzi się do lustrzanego świata.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.en: You've been to mirror world? What's it like?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.pl: Byłaś w lustrzanym świecie? Jaki on jest?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.en: On reflection, it's not that great.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.pl: Po zastanowieniu, nie jest taki wspaniały.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bigmirror/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 1 Find.en: Hey, this one has a message inside!
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 1 Find.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 1 Find.en: Looks like they've all been salvaged from the ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 1 Find.pl: Wygląda na to, że wszystkie zostały wyłowione z oceanu.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 1 Find.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.en: But what if there's something on the back?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.pl: Ale co, jeśli coś jest na odwrocie?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.en: I [i]do[/i] kinda wanna see what's on that piece of paper...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.pl: [i]Właściwie[/i] trochę chcę zobaczyć, co jest na tej kartce...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.en: We can read it just fine.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.en: So, what, you wanna break it open?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.en: Hey, I don't go around breaking [i]your[/i] stuff.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.pl: Hej, ja nie chodzę i nie niszczę [i]twoich[/i] rzeczy.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 2 I Do.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 3 Tadp.en: Hey, I don't go around breaking [i]your[/i] stuff.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 3 Tadp.pl: Hej, ja nie chodzę i nie niszczę [i]twoich[/i] rzeczy.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 3 Tadp.speaker: Tadpole

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 3 Tadp.en: So, what, you wanna break it open?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 3 Tadp.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4a Tad.pl: No cóż - Tadpole tu nie ma...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4a Tad.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4a Tad.en: Thus you're free to start breaking her belongings.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4a Tad.pl: A zatem możesz swobodnie zacząć niszczyć jej rzeczy.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4a Tad.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4b Now.en: Now we can [i]finally[/i] take a proper look at this...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4b Now.pl: Teraz możemy [i]wreszcie[/i] przyjrzeć się temu jak należy...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4b Now.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4c Tha.en: It's a secret third page of the Command Contract...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4c Tha.pl: To tajna trzecia strona Kontraktu Dowódczego...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles 4c Tha.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles others.en: [i]These[/i] aren't the bottles I'm interested in...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles others.pl: [i]Te[/i] nie są butelkami, którymi jestem zainteresowany...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_bottles others.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.en: I thought coral only grew in the ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.pl: Myślałam, że koral rośnie tylko w oceanie.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.en: These shelves are grown from real coral.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.pl: Te półki wyrosły z prawdziwego koralu.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.en: Well, there's a [h]lot[/h] of salt and water in the air...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.pl: Cóż, w powietrzu jest [h]dużo[/h] soli i wody...
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.en: Oh yeah - I can taste it!
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.pl: O tak - czuję to w smaku!
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_coralshelves/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_hangingshells/.en: Anyone can get them for free, they're just lying around.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_hangingshells/.pl: Każdy może je zdobyć za darmo, po prostu leżą wszędzie.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_hangingshells/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_jellyfish/Sect.en: It's two glass bowls and some seashells.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_jellyfish/Sect.pl: To dwie szklane miski i trochę muszelek.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_jellyfish/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_jellyfish/Sect.en:
Right.
But what does it [h]look[/h] like?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_jellyfish/Sect.pl:
No tak.
Ale na co to [h]wygląda?[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_jellyfish/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.en:
It's a ladder.
It doesn't go anywhere though.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.pl:
To drabina.
Niedokądś jednak nie prowadzi.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.en: I imagine it's for lowering into the hole, so you can climb down.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.pl: Wyobrażam sobie, że służy do opuszczenia w otwór, żeby móc po niej zejść.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.en:
Or, you know...
You could use it to display your collection of [i]rusty jewellery.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.pl:
Albo, wiesz...
Mogłabyś jej użyć, żeby wystawić swoją kolekcję [i]zardzewiałej biżuterii.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_ladder/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_pearlnecklace/.en:
A pearl necklace.
With real pearls.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_pearlnecklace/.pl:
Naszyjnik z pereł.
Z prawdziwymi perłami.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_pearlnecklace/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_pearlnecklace/.en: Do you know how much that's [h]worth?[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_pearlnecklace/.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_seaweed/Sectio.en: It really ties the room together.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_seaweed/Sectio.pl: Naprawdę spina ten pokój w całość.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_seaweed/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_shellrow/Secti.en: It's a little family of seashells.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_shellrow/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_smallmirrors/S.en: It's a collection of small mirrors.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_smallmirrors/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_smallmirrors/S.en: You know, it might be fun to start a mirror collection.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_smallmirrors/S.pl: Wiesz, mogłoby być fajnie zacząć kolekcję luster.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_smallmirrors/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_smallmirrors/S.en: I could really see myself doing that.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_smallmirrors/S.pl: Naprawdę mogłabym siebie w tym zobaczyć.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_smallmirrors/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_teacup/Section.en: With an ornate crack down the side.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_teacup/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_towels/Section.en:
Oh, that reminds me...
I need to buy new towels for my bathroom.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_towels/Section.pl:
Och, to mi przypomina...
Muszę kupić nowe ręczniki do łazienki.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_towels/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_towels/Section.en: Sally, we're solving a murder here, focus?
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_towels/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_wood/Section d.en: It's a curved piece of wood.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_wood/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_wood/Section d.en: Looks like it's from the hull of a ship.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_wood/Section d.pl: Wygląda, jakby pochodził z kadłuba statku.
Examine/Exam_Area_Airlock_wood/Section d.speaker: Sally
